info.name: Fastlivery Express - JWT Gateway API
info.description: Fastlivery API collection. Register a customer or log in to obtain a JWT; the collection stores the returned access token for authenticated requests.

request.description: Creates a Customer profile and returns a JWT. The profile ID is saved to the customerId collection variable.
Returns a JWT for the registered account and saves it as the collection accessToken.
Public health check; no token required.
Requires a token and emits a test log line.
Returns a Spring Page of users with optional status, role, verified, email, and name filters.
Returns a Spring Page of customers with optional status, premium, email, and name filters.

request.description: Calculates price through pricing service, finds nearest available driver through user service, and creates a PENDING_CONFIRMATION shipment.
Confirms a PENDING_CONFIRMATION shipment and marks the assigned driver unavailable.
Creates a Stripe Checkout Session and returns the hosted checkout URL.
Retrieves a Stripe Checkout Session and updates shipment paymentStatus.
Returns shipment status, ETA, last known location, and assigned driver's latest location.
Returns a Spring Page of shipments with optional customer, driver, status, payment status, and tracking number filters.
